task: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! First of all, you could, like, attempt to go south. And then, ensure that the hatch is open. Then, move west. After that, move west. And then, recover the Advent Calendar from the floor of the study. That's it!
description:
You're now in a cubicle.

You can see a stand. Looks like someone's already been here and taken everything off it, though. It would have been so cool if there was stuff on the stand.

You need an unguarded exit? You should try going east. There is an unguarded exit to the south.

thought: I should go south as the task suggests to attempt going south first.
feedback:
Well how about that, you are in a place we're calling a cellar.

You can see a rack. The rack is standard. Unfortunately, there isn't a thing on it.

There is a closed hatch leading west. There is an open gate leading east. There is an unguarded exit to the north. There is an exit to the south. Don't worry, it is unblocked.
